График под графиком FPS: сколько миллисе: The chart under the FPS chart: how many milliseconds each frame took. The lower and flatter the line, the smoother the game.
обычный кадр в этот момент: a typical frame at that moment

Рывок — кадр, который шёл вдвое дольше о: A stutter is a frame that took twice as long as a typical one and at least 8 ms longer. From 100 the app subtracts 6 for each stutter per minute (60 at most) and up to 40 for unevenness — when the 1% low frames take 1.5–2.5 times longer than a typical frame. 90 and above means the game ran evenly; below 60, stutters are noticeable.
рывки в первые минуты и при новых сценах: stutters in the first minutes and in new scenes. They usually go away by themselves; don't clear the shader cache without a reason
рывки совпадают с чтением диска игрой. П: stutters match the game reading from the drive. Moving the game to an SSD helps
в эти моменты процессор занят целиком —: at these moments the CPU is fully busy — often with background programs
закройте лишнее или понизьте качество те: close what you don't need or lower texture quality
по записанным данным ничто не совпало с: nothing in the recorded data matched the stutters — the app says so
Во время записи программа раз в пару сек: While recording, every couple of seconds the app checks which programs other than the game load the CPU and the drive. It's a light check that doesn't affect the game.
В списке «Просадки» у каждой просадки на: In the Drops list each drop shows what happened at the same time: for example, “OneDrive was using the drive” or “Windows Defender was scanning files”. Defender is only named here: the app doesn't read or change its settings.
Блок «Что ещё работало во время игры» —: The “What else ran during the game” block lists programs that loaded the computer on average and at the heaviest moment.
игра была свёрнута или кадров не было: the game was minimized or there were no frames

Оценка 0–100 на «Обзоре», в правой колон: A 0–100 score on the Overview tab, in the right column under the program list. It is based on Diagnostics findings and how games ran over the last two weeks.
снижает оценку на 15: например, синие эк: lowers the score by 15: for example, blue screens, uncorrected hardware errors, games on integrated graphics
рывки (средняя плавность ниже 75), перег: stutters (average smoothness below 75), graphics card overheating, low memory
компьютер в хорошем состоянии: the computer is in good shape

Оценка считается сама раз в день (не во: The score is calculated by itself once a day (never during a game) and after every check on the Diagnostics tab. Recalculate checks the system again right now. The chart under the number shows the score by day for a month; the last bar is today.
Если игр за две недели было мало или гра: If there were few games in two weeks or the chart has only started filling up, the app says so: the conclusions are rough for now.

The app never closes parts of Windows, security programs or anti-cheats. When memory is low you'll see “Free up memory” next to it, and for other causes — a link to the right section.
Если тормозит в игре — после игры открой: If a game is slow, open its report after playing: it shows what got in the way exactly at the moment of each drop.
После каждой проверки пересчитывается и: After every check, PC health on the Overview tab is recalculated too.
Кроме сбоев Windows, проверка смотрит на: Besides Windows crashes, the check looks at hardware and drivers. Each finding comes with an explanation and what to do.
работает ли память на своей скорости. Пр: whether memory runs at its speed. The app compares it with the official speed for your CPU and says “the profile looks off” only when that is clearly visible. On a laptop XMP is never suggested
две планки в одном канале работают медле: two sticks in one channel run slower — the app suggests which slots to move them to (check your motherboard manual)
кабель монитора включён в разъём платы,: the monitor cable is plugged into the motherboard, not the graphics card: games run on integrated graphics. On a laptop this is normal
работает ли карта на полной ширине шины: whether the card runs at the full bus width (x16) and whether Resizable BAR is on — where this can be read reliably
износ и температура SSD, TRIM, почти зап: SSD wear and temperature, TRIM, an almost full SSD, a game on a hard drive if it stuttered because of the drive
хватает ли запаса мощности. Впишите мощн: whether there's enough power headroom. Enter the power supply wattage in Electricity; without it the app only estimates the load. Not checked on a laptop
XMP/EXPO — профиль разгона памяти. На не: XMP/EXPO is a memory overclocking profile. On some computers it causes crashes, freezes, memory errors or boot problems. First check that your motherboard supports this speed (the memory list on the board maker's website). If problems appear after turning it on, turn the profile off in BIOS or reset BIOS settings.
код ошибки простыми словами и, если сохр: the error code in plain words and, if a small memory dump was saved, the culprit driver. Reading dumps requires administrator rights
сколько за неделю и за месяц, что сбоит: how many in a week and in a month, what fails — CPU, memory or the PCIe bus — and what to check
какой модуль уронил игру: драйвер видеок: which module crashed the game: the graphics driver, an anti-cheat, low memory and other common cases
если после установки нового драйвера вид: if crashes became more frequent after a new graphics driver was installed — advice to go back to the previous version. The app doesn't roll back the driver itself
как долго включается компьютер и что тор: how long the computer takes to start and what slows startup down
At the bottom of the tab there are three checks with a button. They work only with administrator rights.
смотрит, не повреждены ли системные файл: checks whether Windows system files are damaged. About a minute, changes nothing. If it finds damage, it shows commands you can run yourself
средство Windows проверяет память при пе: the Windows tool tests memory on restart, 10–20 minutes. The computer restarts only after you confirm; the result appears here after it starts
полминуты следит, какие драйверы надолго: for half a minute watches which drivers hold the CPU for too long. Audio clicks and stutters with good FPS are a common sign of such delays
Внизу вкладки «Сеть» — проверки по кнопк: At the bottom of the Network tab there are checks with a button. The app doesn't change network or router settings, it only gives advice.
диапазон (2,4, 5 или 6 ГГц), уровень сиг: band (2.4, 5 or 6 GHz), signal strength, channel and standard. Advice: 2.4 GHz while gaming, weak signal, a crowded channel
трассировка до сервера игры или до 1.1.1: a trace to the game server or to 1.1.1.1: from which hop the loss starts — at home, at the provider or further. Intermediate hops often don't answer ping — that isn't always loss
как быстро отвечает ваш DNS-сервер по ср: how fast your DNS server answers compared with 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8 and 77.88.8.8. The app doesn't change DNS — if another one is much faster, it tells you where to change it
драйвер видеокарты, BIOS и сама программ: graphics driver, BIOS and the app itself; you can let updates install by themselves
все программы и игры, поиск, сортировка: all programs and games, search, sorting and removal with the program's own uninstaller
батарея, режим питания и фирменная прогр: battery, power mode and the maker's own app — the section exists only on a laptop
сколько стоит час игры и месяц работы: в: what an hour of gaming and a month of use cost: enter your rate (time-of-day zones too) and the power supply wattage

название, издатель, версия, дата установ: name, publisher, version, install date and size. System components and Windows updates are hidden

все игры, которые видит программа, и пер: all games the app sees, and the game search switches
«Удалить» запускает деинсталлятор самой: Uninstall runs the program's own uninstaller — after you confirm. It can't be undone, only reinstalled. Antiviruses, drivers and Pulse PC itself have no such button: they are removed with their own tools.
Программы, установленные для всех пользо: Programs installed for all users can be removed only with administrator rights.
Раздел вкладки «Система», который появля: A section of the System tab that appears only on a laptop. The app changes nothing here — it shows and tells you where to switch.
ёмкость сейчас и у новой батареи, износ: current and design capacity, wear and cycle count if the battery reports them
какой режим Windows включён от зарядки и: which Windows mode is on when plugged in and on battery, and where to switch it
если установлена программа производителя: if the maker's app is installed (Armoury Crate, Lenovo Vantage, MSI Center, OMEN and others) — where its Turbo or Performance mode is
уведомление, если игра идёт без зарядки:: a notification if a game runs without the charger: the CPU and graphics card are limited during that time
На ноутбуке программа не советует то, чт: On a laptop the app doesn't suggest things that only apply to a desktop PC: XMP, moving memory sticks, the power supply and the monitor cable into the graphics card. The Overview tab shows a laptop instead of a PC case.
В разделе «Новые версии» можно включить: In Updates (app) you can turn on “Install updates automatically”. Then a new version is downloaded in the background, verified just as with the button, and installed the next time the app starts or when you step away from the PC. Never during a game. After the update you get a short note about what's new.
Если рядом с PulsePC.exe лежит файл port: If a portable.txt file lies next to PulsePC.exe, history and settings are kept in the Data folder next to the app, and startup and the Windows list of installed apps are left alone. The portable version is updated manually: the link to the new version is in Updates (app); unpack the archive over the old folder, the Data folder stays.
how many milliseconds one frame takes. At 60 FPS it's about 17 ms
